Name: L_Orbicularis
Description: Will create Orbicularis Outside Eyelids Rig

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Will create Orbicularis Outside Eyelids Rig.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetParent: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- SetGeo: set the node/object name this block should use.
- Template parent examples: Head_Jnt, Head_Ctrl, Spine_End_Jnt.

Tips:
- start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need.
